numerical_correctness.diagnosis: Distribution is nearly flat (67.4 vs 66.5 across top-5). A correct run shows a clearly dominant top-1. This indicates a structural bug, not rounding.

likely_causes_unverified: Missing BOS token: llama.cpp prepends BOS automatically; the tokenizer output starts at 1724 with no BOS. A missing BOS shifts every position embedding.
RMSNorm bias: this model carries attn/ffn norm biases, which is unusual; if they are applied at the wrong stage the residual stream is wrong.
RoPE convention: rotate_half pairing and the offset may not match the reference layout.
Expert weight orientation: gate/up/down may need a different transpose than assumed.
Attention mask or GQA head grouping.
